scientific.integrity: The PAGE specialization is reduced exactly to a two-state i.i.d. random linear system. Its three-dimensional second-moment lifting is derived by branch enumeration, and the full cubic Jury criterion is proved to reduce to one binding inequality.
limitations: Two scalar components, full-batch refresh, one-sample recursive correction, and refresh probability one third only.
Mean-square stability rather than pathwise monotonicity is classified.
Higher-dimensional noncommuting Hessians and other refresh probabilities are not covered.
Equivalent calculations may exist under random-linear-system terminology outside optimization-focused searches.

title: Sharp mean-square stability frontier for two-component PAGE
